claims.content: To configure the security setting of the entire system based on User Group by allocating the available roles to a user group and capturing the Group Code, Group Name, Screen Name, and New, Edit, Delete, View, and Print Allowed/Not Allowed permissions.

goal.raw_text: To configure the security setting of the entire system based on User Group by allocating the available roles to a user group and capturing the Group Code, Group Name, Screen Name, and New, Edit, Delete, View, and Print Allowed/Not Allowed permissions.

claims.content: System Administrator
The user is the system admin, because only the system admin can create User Groups.
The User Group name to be created does not already exist; the system should not allow a User Group with an existing name.
The System Administrator initiates creation of a new User Group.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates creation of a new User Group.

claims.content: The system admin creates a new User Group.
The system allocates the roles available in the system to the User Group.
The system captures Group Code and Group Name.
The system captures Screen Name and New – Allowed / Not Allowed.
The system captures Edit – Allowed / Not Allowed, Delete – Allowed / Not Allowed, View – Allowed / Not Allowed, and Print – Allowed / Not Allowed.
The system treats the above information as mandatory while creating a new User Group.
The system does not allow the user to create a User Group with an existing name.
If the System Administrator attempts to create a new User Group with an existing name, the system does not allow the user to create a User Group with existing names.
If the actor attempting to create a User Group is not the System Administrator, the system does not allow the creation because the system admin only can create User Groups; exit the use case.

If any mandatory information captured for a new User Group is missing, the system does not create the User Group because the above information is mandatory while creating a new User Group; exit the use case.
If the System Administrator attempts to create a User Group with an existing name, the system does not allow the user to create a User Group with existing names; exit the use case.
The security setting of the entire system is based on the User Group.
The roles available in the system are allocated to the User Group.
The User Group creation has captured Group Code and Group Name as master part information.
The User Group creation has captured Screen Name and New – Allowed / Not Allowed as transaction part information.
The User Group creation has captured Edit – Allowed / Not Allowed, Delete – Allowed / Not Allowed, View – Allowed / Not Allowed, and Print – Allowed / Not Allowed.
The above information is mandatory and has been captured while creating the new User Group.
The User Group was created without an existing name because the system does not allow a User Group with existing names.
